ideas.pitch: A local multi-user dashboard designed specifically for ICPC-style contests to monitor team member coding states, lock files, and calculate live penalty strategies on a single shared laptop.
ideas.problem_statement: Stage 2: Onsite Round - 5 hours, 7-8 programming problems using only one shared laptop among 2-3 team members.
ideas.title: Codeforces Team Sync & Penalty Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the logistical bottleneck of sharing a single computer in the onsite ICPC-style final at IIIT Nagpur, keeping teammates synchronized on debugging and submission strategy.

ideas.pitch: An offline sandbox tool for competitive programmers to rapidly write generator scripts, run stress tests against brute force solutions, and visualize memory/time limits for edge cases.
ideas.problem_statement: Stage 2: Onsite Round - challenging algorithmic problems requiring rigorous testing under tight time constraints.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Complexity Visualizer & Stress Tester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact pain point of failing hidden test cases during competitive coding contests by automating stress testing before submission.

ideas.pitch: A specialized IDE extension for competitive programmers that dynamically scaffolds advanced data structures (Segment Trees, Suffix Automata, Dinic) optimized for speed.
ideas.problem_statement: Stage 1 and Stage 2: ICPC-style national-level coding competition requiring high coding speed and accuracy.
ideas.title: CP Template Manager and Snippet Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Speed is crucial in ICPC-style contests; having pre-tested, bug-free implementations of complex algorithms instantly available saves precious minutes.

ideas.pitch: A platform that reconstructs past Codeforces contests with custom team timers and virtual room simulations to train teams for national-level pressure.
ideas.problem_statement: Preliminary online round followed by on-campus finale at IIIT Nagpur testing teamwork and creativity under pressure.
ideas.title: Virtual ICPC Scoreboard & Upsolving Replayer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the mental pressure of national-level contests by providing realistic simulation environments for team coordination practice.

ideas.pitch: An offline static analysis tool that scans competitor codebases during practice sessions to detect potential integer overflows, unoptimized loops, and missing edge-case checks.
ideas.problem_statement: Stage 1: Preliminary Coding Contest on Codeforces requiring handling 5-6 programming problems under strict penalties.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Hint & Suboptimal Route Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Minimizes costly penalty ticks on Codeforces by catching common WA (Wrong Answer) and TLE (Time Limit Exceeded) traps locally.
